notes.automatedChecksPassed: Boolean. True means automated verification has passed.
notes.risk: Technical risk category such as privacy, authentication, payment, migration, provider-state, destructive, release, environment, or performance.
notes.accessAvailable: Boolean. False means the required environment is unavailable.

notes.blocked: Blocked item records preserving id and naming the concrete reason, owner, and next action.
notes.status: Ready to ship when automatedChecksPassed is true.
notes.deploymentAuthorized: Always false; release requires separate approval.
notes.designReview: Object with ariaLabel, focusVisible, and narrowViewportChecked booleans.
